tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the signed-in person's VibeFix checks (one per app checked), with the status of each. Call this when they ask which of their apps VibeFix has checked. To read a check's result, call get_check_result with its check_id (the id listed here).

tools.name: check_repair_status
tools.description: Report whether one check on the signed-in VibeFix account is still running or finished. For what the check found, call get_check_result instead. Use the id from list_projects.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "confirm_fix" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assess_broken_app, get_fix_options, check_live_app · Private data: get_fix_options · Public sink: assess_broken_app, check_live_app, confirm_fix · Destructive: get_fix_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assess_broken_app, get_fix_options, check_live_app · Private data: get_fix_options · Public sink: assess_broken_app, check_live_app, confirm_fix · Destructive: get_fix_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "assess_broken_app" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
